summary: U.S. Bancorp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on June 24, 2026, announcing its Stress Capital Buffer requirement will remain at 2.6% through October 1, 2027, per the Federal Reserve's CCAR. It also disclosed a planned quarterly common dividend increase from $0.52 to $0.54 per share, subject to board approval, starting Q3 2026. This is a routine regulatory update with a dividend hike—not a special situation. There is no M&A, activist, restructuring, or strategic review. The filing is a standard capital-plan disclosure. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply; watch for board approval of the dividend.
